snippet.title: Teeto - Official Trailer - Demo on Steam
snippet.description:
WISHLIST & PLAY THE DEMO on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2783370/Teeto/

Join us on Discord: https://discord.com/invite/cgYdDNgkbh

Teeto is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a tiny blob and bunny duo on an extraordinary journey. Absorb objects from the world, harnessing their powers to fight the shadow corruption and help out a cast of crazy characters in an action packed adventure! 

Teeto can absorb objects from the environment and instantly take on their form. Nory, using a high-tech backpack she engineered that harnesses the powerful Vionite energy, taps into Teeto's forms to activate unique powers and abilities.

Twitter: https://x.com/EatPantGames
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/eatpantgames.com
